Full text:\n\n```python\n#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Loopback PoC harness: netrc credentials forwarded across an HTTP redirect.\n\nThe script drives the HTTP client binary under test (curl-style options)\nagainst a server bound to 127.0.0.1 and reports, as a normalized transcript,\nexactly what the server received.  The scenario probes whether credentials\ntaken from a .netrc file for host A are re-sent when the server redirects the\nclient to a different host B on the same address — the behavior shape of\nCVE-2025-0167 (curl netrc credentials leaked on redirect).\n\nPer run the script:\n  1. binds an HTTP server to 127.0.0.1 on an ephemeral port;\n  2. creates a temporary .netrc file in a temporary directory it owns\n     (machine a.localhost, login alice, password secretpw, plus an empty\n     `default` entry) and removes it afterwards;\n  3. launches the binary as:\n\n       <binary> -L --max-redirs 3\n                 --resolve a.localhost:<port>:127.0.0.1\n                 --resolve b.localhost:<port>:127.0.0.1\n                 --netrc-file <tmpdir>/.netrc\n                 http://a.localhost:<port>/\n\n  4. answers `GET /` with 301 + `Location: http://b.localhost:<port>/followed`\n     (empty body) and every other path with 200 + body `OK`;\n  5. lets the client finish, stops the server and emits one JSON object\n     (stdout, plus --json-out when given) describing the run, with the\n     transcript under observable.value, one line per received request:\n\n       REQ <index> host=<Host header> auth=<Authorization header or \"none\">\n\nA client that keeps netrc credentials host-scoped sends Basic auth only for\na.localhost (REQ 1); one that leaks them re-sends it for b.localhost (REQ 2).\n\nEverything stays on loopback, no external hosts are contacted, at most two\nrequests are exchanged, and nothing is read interactively.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport argparse\nimport json\nimport os\nimport signal\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nimport tempfile\nimport threading\nimport time\nimport urllib.parse\nfrom http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer\n\n# Exact content required for the temporary .netrc file.\nNETRC_CONTENT = \"machine a.localhost\\nlogin alice\\npassword secretpw\\ndefault\\n\"\n\n# Environment keys removed for the child process so it cannot be diverted\n# through a proxy or reconfigured via a start-up config file (~/.curlrc):\n# determinism over the loopback conversation matters more than inheritance.\n_STRIP_ENV_KEYS = frozenset({\n    \"http_proxy\", \"https_proxy\", \"all_proxy\", \"ftp_proxy\", \"no_proxy\",\n    \"XDG_CONFIG_HOME\",\n})\n\n\nclass RecordingHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):\n    \"\"\"Fixed scenario responses;
